errors.evidence: The major grid lines on the y-axis are spaced by 200 units (5700, 5900, 6100, etc.), not 100.

The description incorrectly states the fluctuation range of the solid line. The line's values actually range from a minimum below 6000 (around 5940) to a maximum near 6500 (around 6480), which is much wider than the stated 6100 to 6300 range.
The dashed line is visibly positioned above the 6500 grid line, not exactly at 6500. Its value is approximately 6550.
